lines.the_sun_was_cruel_today: The sun was cruel today. I waited in the cellar until it set.
lines.i_miss_breakfast: I miss breakfast. The taste of it, anyway.
lines.the_nights_feel_short: The nights feel so short in summer.
lines.i_hear_every_heartbeat: The village is so loud at night. Every little sound.
lines.no_mirror_in_my_house: I took the mirror down. I didn't like what it didn't show.
